answer: Beacon spot checks with heartbeats block bulk fakes. Each epoch the beacon sends a cipher only the live key holder can answer. Verifiers split replies through a prism of checks: key, timing, history. Heartbeats must carry work, like timber bearing weight. N fakes need N ciphers and N heartbeats: at 20 POA each per epoch, 1,000 fakes cost 20,000 POA per epoch, no discount; caught fakes lose their bond. Honest agents pay once, rewards undiluted.
